# raff_security_group (Resource)

Manages a Raff security group — a named set of inbound/outbound rules attached to VM NICs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Security group name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Security group description.
- `rule` (Block List) Inbound and outbound rules. Updates replace the entire rule set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))
- `template_id` (String) Seed from a template at create time. Template rules are copied, then merged with any explicit `rule` blocks.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `project_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `vm_count` (Number) Number of VM NICs currently using this security group.

<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `protocol` (String) Network protocol (TCP, UDP, ICMP, ICMPV6, ALL).
- `rule_type` (String) Direction of traffic (inbound or outbound).

Optional:

- `icmp_type` (Number) ICMP message type (only for ICMP/ICMPV6).
- `ip` (String) Source/destination IP. Empty means any.
- `range` (String) Port or port range. Single port (`80`) or range (`8000:9000`). Empty for ICMP/ALL.
- `size` (Number) CIDR block size (e.g. `24` for /24). Used with `ip`.
